headline: Man beaten to death at Suhrawardy Hospital on child abduction suspicion
summary: A 41-year-old man, allegedly mentally unstable, was killed by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital on Wednesday night.
details: A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.
The incident occurred around 11 PM when families of children receiving treatment at the hospital grew suspicious of Sheikh, who was roaming near the children's ward.
When questioned, Sheikh was reportedly unable to provide a satisfactory answer, leading a group of people to drag him downstairs and beat him severely until he died on the spot.
Police recovered the body after receiving a report via the national emergency service 999. His identity was later confirmed via fingerprints.
The family of the deceased, a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka, claims that Alam Sheikh was mentally unstable.
Tejgaon Division Police Deputy Commissioner Ibne Mizan stated that the police have detained the mastermind of the incident and a case will be filed against them.
caption:
A man was beaten to death by a mob at a Dhaka hospital after being suspected of child abduction.

A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.

The incident occurred around 11 PM when families of children receiving treatment at the hospital grew suspicious of Sheikh, who was roaming near the children's ward.

When questioned, Sheikh was reportedly unable to provide a satisfactory answer, leading a group of people to drag him downstairs and beat him severely until he died on the spot.

Police recovered the body after receiving a report via the national emergency service 999. His identity was later confirmed via fingerprints.

The family of the deceased, a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka, claims that Alam Sheikh was mentally unstable.

Tejgaon Division Police Deputy Commissioner Ibne Mizan stated that the police have detained the mastermind of the incident and a case will be filed against them.

headline: Over 2,300 tourists stranded as Army exchanges fire with armed group in Sajek
summary: A road blockade by local organisations led to a massive tourist deadlock, followed by a shootout between security forces and the UPDF near Ujo Bazar.
details: The Bangladesh Army exchanged fire with an armed group on Thursday morning in Sajek, Rangamati, as they attempted to clear a road blockade that had stranded over 2,300 tourists.
caption:
Over 2,300 tourists were stranded in Sajek after a road blockade sparked a shootout between the Army and an armed group.

The Bangladesh Army exchanged fire with an armed group on Thursday morning in Sajek, Rangamati, as they attempted to clear a road blockade that had stranded over 2,300 tourists.
